accountDelete.title: Delete account
accountDelete.intent: Do you really want to delete your account?
accountDelete.scope: Your account will be deleted permanently, with all tasks, series, pillars, categories and settings. This cannot be undone.

refused.subscription_active: Your account still has a running subscription. Cancel it in the settings first, then delete your account.
refused.last_group_admin: You are the last admin of a group with other members. First make someone else an admin in the group settings or dissolve the group.
